known_limitations: Uses a simple single-process demo implementation rather than a production-ready store backend.
Image uploads are not fully implemented as binary storage; the app focuses on catalog, cart, checkout, admin editing, import, and audit basics.
Payment processing is simulated through a trusted-provider placeholder and does not integrate with a real gateway.
Customer accounts and authentication are simplified and not fully implemented.
Some unresolved requirements were intentionally left out, such as advanced payment channels, customer-specific limits, and complex order review workflows.
